title: Control flow: @for
summary: Repeat a template for each item in a list with @for, track, $index and @empty.

options: To tell Angular which item is which, so it can reuse page elements when the list changes
To limit the list to ten items
To make the loop run backwards
quiz.explain: Tracking by a unique value such as `id` lets Angular move or update only the changed rows instead of rebuilding all of them.

quiz.q: Finish the loop so each student is tracked by its id.
quiz.explain: The loop header is `item of list; track expression`.
The `@empty` block is shown when the list has no items.

quiz.q: What does `$index` give you inside a @for block?
options: The position of the current item, starting at 0
quiz.explain: `$index` starts at 0, so people often show `$index + 1` as a row number.
